items.name: Shyam Iyer
items.quote: ATC India is using Invendis to monitor tower operations across ~70,000+ towers. Invendis has provided trouble-ticketing, mobile-based field interface, and real-time alarm monitoring — aiding field efficiency.

items.name: Alexander Pigall
items.quote: I feel Invendis is a company that listens and does all they can to meet my needs. There is open, honest communication on all levels and a process to improve where things fail. Transparency is key.

items.name: Hans Moritz
items.quote: Our enterprise system combines Asset Management (ERP), WO & TT System, RMS (Invendis), and Electronic Key System. Invendis RMS auto-generates trouble tickets with alarms to manage all end-to-end processes.
